name: Trident of Seafury
body:
School evocation [cold, water]; Level: magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, storm knight 4

Components: V,S,M (a small trident made of coral harvested during winter)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 0 ft.

Effect: a two-handed trident of ice

Duration: 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw: See below; Spell Resistance: yes (see below)

A large, two-handed magic trident of steel-hard ice appears in your hand, which only you can use. You are considered proficient with the weapon. The trident counts as a magic, cold iron reach weapon with a +2 enhancement bonus per three caster levels (max +6), inflicts 1d10 damage, and critical on an 18-20/x2. Half the damage is piercing and half is cold damage. The trident can also be used to coat an opponent that was just hit with a layer of ice. Activating this effect is a swift action. This ice slows the target (Reflex save negates, spell resistance applicable) for one round per two caster levels, but the trident immediately shatters if the ice attack is successful. Cold type creatures are immune to this effect.
